originalTitle: The Hidden Aura: The Legend of Ivy Wilson
overview: In a world where magic is strictly forbidden outside the mystical Lupen City, a friendless outcast hiding her true identity discovers she is the next vessel for an ancient, cosmic Fox spirit. Hunted by a ruthless cult leader and unable to access her fractured powers, she must return to her birthplace to solve a 500-year-old mystery, reunite with the physical Aura, and stop a universe-ending threat.  An original anime series by BILLYFTSKYKID STUDIO, Lagos Nigeria. Trailer coming 2027. Season 1 coming 2027.
